title: Student app · Connexion
question: The new login screen of the student app: the student types the personal code the centre gave them (code only, the phone remembers them). The world stays the app's (lavender, white, plum-ink pill, subject colours, Fredoka + Quicksand). Pick one structure, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Ta semaine en couleurs
options.lineage: the 3e B week grid, Monday to Saturday, painted in subject colours
options.thesis: The top of the screen is the collège's week as a wall of subject-coloured blocks; the login is a white sheet rising under it.
materials: six day columns of rounded class blocks, no text
options.viewport: Upper 55 %: Lun to Sam columns of class blocks in Maths violet, PC teal, SVT green, Français pink, Anglais amber, HG coral, with the logo on a white chip; lower 45 %: « Entre ton code élève », code cells, « Se connecter », « Pas de code ? Demande-le à l'accueil ».
options.risk: Without labels the week can read as a pattern until the student knows the app; the blocks must stay recognisable as a timetable.

regions.label: week wall: Lun–Sam blocks in subject colours + logo chip

options.label: Le mur des cours
options.lineage: the year's real lessons: f(x) = ax + b, U = R × I, AM/AB = AN/AC, 1939-1945, have + past participle
options.thesis: Behind the login, the year's real content is written large in soft subject tints; each character typed lights one formula in its colour.
materials: Fredoka formulas in subject washes, slow drift
options.viewport: Rows of formulas and dates fill the screen edge to edge; a white card in the middle holds the logo, « Bonjour ! », the code field and « Se connecter »; a valid code lights the whole wall, then « Bonjour Yanis ».
options.risk: A busy backdrop behind a form can cost focus for TDAH and DYS students; calm mode must freeze it and the tints must stay quiet.

regions.label: wall: f(x) = ax + b · U = R × I · 1939-1945
wall continues, formulas light as you type

options.label: Le grand code
options.lineage: the code card the centre hands out, its characters at poster scale
options.thesis: Almost nothing on screen but the code itself, in monumental cells over a slow violet-to-pink light field.
materials: soft moving light field at the bottom
options.viewport: Logo at the top, « Ton code élève » and three groups of large cells across the width, a help line, then the light field rising behind the « Se connecter » pill; a valid code sweeps the light up into the home screen.
options.risk: A soft gradient field is a common login look; it only holds if the cells are truly monumental and the field stays in the brand's own colours.
